note: Roles, mechanisms, topologies, scope and mutability are independent dimensions, not mutually exclusive approved classes. Deterministic Worker is not silently relabeled as an LLM Operative.

link_types.label: Data / artifact handoff
link_types.purpose: Carries allowed data or a versioned artifact reference.
link_types.required_contract_details: Schema, classification, permitted endpoints, integrity, retention, release authorization.

link_types.label: Invocation / result
link_types.purpose: Requests one declared capability and returns a typed result.
link_types.required_contract_details: Operation identity, preconditions, effects, correlation, idempotency, timeout and uncertain-result policy.

link_types.label: Work dependency
link_types.purpose: States an output or prerequisite needed by another DAG node.
link_types.required_contract_details: Exact DAG revision, acyclicity and required acceptance; not necessarily a message route.

link_types.label: Delegation
link_types.purpose: Assigns bounded work or explicitly attenuated permission.
link_types.required_contract_details: Issuer, subject, exact obligation, scope ceiling, time and budget; no authority by implication.

link_types.label: Supervision / hierarchy
link_types.purpose: Describes lifecycle responsibility or organizational reporting.
link_types.required_contract_details: Owner, permitted lifecycle controls and separate current grants.

link_types.label: Membership
link_types.purpose: Associates a participant with a Cell/team and role.
link_types.required_contract_details: Scope, validity interval and handoff duties; not access permission.

link_types.label: Resource binding / lease
link_types.purpose: References or reserves use of an owned resource.
link_types.required_contract_details: Owner rules, quantity, expiry, capacity, contention and recovery.

link_types.label: Context / knowledge reference
link_types.purpose: Selects a permitted source or knowledge package for a step.
link_types.required_contract_details: Version, rights, freshness, inclusion reason and provenance.

link_types.label: Evidence / provenance
link_types.purpose: Connects support, contradiction, derivation and source lineage.
link_types.required_contract_details: Relation meaning, exact subject/source versions and applicability.

link_types.label: Event subscription
link_types.purpose: Describes interest in specified event kinds and delivery.
link_types.required_contract_details: Topic/profile, release and receive policy, ordering, duplicates, replay and expiry.

link_types.label: Approval / policy binding
link_types.purpose: Binds a transition to required decisions and enforcement rules.
link_types.required_contract_details: Exact action/version, current validity, decision maker and deterministic enforcement.

link_types.label: Federation / exchange agreement
link_types.required_contract_details: Identity mapping, data rights, locally enforceable constraints, failures, exit and revocation.

mechanism: permitted transition or protected revision proposal
